cards.text: **How do you pull a bow with no arms?**
**Loidhar, Kishtwar, J&K. 2007.** Sheetal Devi is born.
She has **phocomelia**, a rare condition. She has **no arms**.
She learned to shoot with her **legs and feet**.
With coach **Kuldeep Vedwan**, she trained until it became **second nature**.
**2023:** she wins **two golds** at the **Asian Para Games**.
She finishes the year as **world No. 1**.
**2025:** she wins the **World Championship gold** in Gwangju.
She becomes the **first armless woman** to win a world title.
